approved: High Speed Rail Planning Authority Bill 2015

The High Speed Rail Planning Authority Bill 2015 was supported, proposing an 11-person authority to plan a Brisbane–Melbourne high-speed rail link via Newcastle, Sydney, and Canberra. A study cited found $2.15 in economic benefit per dollar invested for the Sydney–Melbourne section and 84 million passengers per year once fully operational, while the government was criticised for cutting $54 million in previously allocated funding.
